manifest.settings.title: i18n-LE Settings
manifest.settings.copy.clipboard.desc: Copy each report to the clipboard as well as opening it
manifest.settings.keys-are-source.desc: Treat each key as the English string itself, as in a VS Code bundle.l10n.json. The layout normally decides this on its own.
manifest.settings.library.desc: Which i18n library wrote the catalogues. Auto identifies it from the project — manifests, config files, the layout, the catalogue syntax and call sites — and refuses rather than guesses when the evidence does not agree.
manifest.settings.library.option.auto: Identify the library from the project
manifest.settings.library.option.i18next: i18next and react-i18next: double-brace placeholders and key-suffix plurals
manifest.settings.library.option.flutter: Flutter ARB files: ICU messages with @key metadata
manifest.settings.source.desc: The catalogue every other one is measured against, as a file name or a language tag such as en. Leave empty to use the one English catalogue.
manifest.settings.open.side-by-side.desc: Open the report in a new editor to the side
manifest.settings.statusbar.enabled.desc: Show the i18n-LE status bar entry for quick access
manifest.settings.telemetry.desc: Enable local-only telemetry logs to the Output panel
manifest.mcp.label: i18n-LE translation catalogue audit for agent mode
